threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the tube' when you mean the Overground, and you haven't realized Hackney is a whole vibe, not just a postcode.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with old Spice Girls hits. Even the driver was chuckling. Brixton nights, eh?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler in a pink tutu riding a bicycle with a parrot on her shoulder near Reuterplatz. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a taco stand next to a classic currywurst joint, where lunchtime debates merge flavors and cultures seamlessly.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they expertly dodge those potholes on Valencia while juggling a burrito and a coffee. Tourists just step in them.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 38 Geary playing a ukulele while the bus jerked to a stop. Every strum matched the bumps, like he was composing a song just for us.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is only about Gaudí, but the real gems are the tiny plazas where locals sip café amb llet, not the famous park.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stand staring at the metro map, not realizing Google Maps is often more confusing underground than above.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look around confused when the bus driver shouts out street names like they've just won a jackpot. Just wait till you get used to it.
Caught a glimpse of someone arguing with a statue outside the Ritzy last night. Guess even the bus drivers have a bit of late-night drama to share.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted that little corner store selling fresh baklava at 2 AM. The sweet smell wafted through the street, and I thought, 'Yep, this is home.'

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous open-air films in the middle of the park, complete with a packed picnic vibe and strangers sharing snacks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they shrug off BART delays. A newbie panics; we just check Twitter and grab a burrito.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission packed with chatty tourists, but hilarious when a local yelled, 'Look, it’s the bus tour!' Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are for chillin', but locals know they're just the backstage for evening pregames before heading out.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at the metro ticket machines—standing there baffled while locals swipe on autopilot.
